    FROM [AuctionM_dbuser].[tblAuctionAssets] AS [t2]
    INNER JOIN [AuctionM_dbuser].[tblAssets] AS [t3] ON [t2].[AssetId] = [t3].[AssetId]
) AS [s] ON [t].[AuctionId] = [s].[AuctionId]
WHERE [t].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
ORDER BY [t].[AuctionId], [t0].[CategoryId], [t1].[StatusId], [s].[AuctionAssetId]
